feat: Implement automatic changelog tracking and widget embedding system

- Added `ChangelogViewer` component to display tracked widget views and updates.
- Introduced `WidgetEmbed` component to load production widget HTML from GitHub.
- Created `changelogTracker` utility for managing changelog entries in localStorage.
- Updated widget configuration mapping in `widgetConfig.ts` for easier management.
- Enhanced styling and functionality for changelog exports (text and JSON).
- Fixed header-to-content spacing issue in global styles.
- Documented changes and usage in `CHANGELOG-TRACKING.md` and `WIDGET-EMBED-GUIDE.md`.
\n\nAuthor: mccal
